skill.name: internal-comms

skill.summary: Drafts structured internal updates with company-specific formats and concise messaging guidance.

content.value_statement: Internal updates need consistent structure and clear tone across teams. This skill provides formats for 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, and general communications.
actual_capabilities: Selects guidance for 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ answers, and general internal communications.
Structures 3P updates into Progress, Plans, and Problems sections.
Creates newsletter outlines with sections for announcements, priorities, leadership updates, and social updates.
Formats employee FAQ responses with concise question and answer pairs.
Asks for audience, purpose, tone, and formatting when a request needs more context.
limitations: It does not provide live access to Slack, email, calendar, or documents by itself.
It depends on user-provided context or separately connected tools for accurate company details.
It does not verify confidential information or approval status.
It does not replace legal, HR, or executive review for sensitive announcements.

use_cases.title: Weekly Team 3P Update
use_cases.description: Turn weekly progress, plans, and blockers into a concise executive-ready update.

use_cases.title: Company Newsletter Draft
use_cases.description: Convert recent announcements, milestones, and links into a structured company-wide newsletter.

use_cases.title: Employee FAQ Summary
use_cases.description: Collect common employee questions and draft clear answers with source links.

prompt_templates.title: Create a 3P Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a weekly team update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 3P update for the [team] covering [dates]. Use these notes for Progress, Plans, and Problems: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Company Newsletter
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a company newsletter for [time period]. Organize these announcements, milestones, leadership updates, and links into clear sections: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Build an Employee FAQ
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for answering repeated employee questions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an employee FAQ from these questions and source notes. Keep each answer concise, cite authoritative sources, and flag uncertain answers: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Leadership Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for sensitive or cross-functional updates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a leadership-ready internal update for [audience]. Combine the key message, source links, risks, open questions, and requested actions: [details].

output_examples.input: Weekly notes for the Payments team mention invoice retry shipped, webhook cleanup planned, and a tax API blocker.
output_examples.output:
Payments Team (July 1-7)
Progress: Shipped invoice retry and reduced failed billing recovery work.
Plans: Finish webhook cleanup and publish migration notes next week.
Problems: The tax API blocker needs partner support before launch.

output_examples.input: Company updates include a new product milestone, an all-hands recap, hiring progress, and an external press mention.
output: Company Announcements: Summarizes the product milestone and links the all-hands recap.
Progress on Priorities: Highlights hiring progress and the next operating focus.
External News: Notes the press mention and points employees to the approved article.

output_examples.input: Employees are asking about launch timing, hiring plans, and where to find the new roadmap.
output_examples.output:
Question: When is the launch planned?
Answer: The current target is listed in the launch plan. Confirm with the product lead before sharing externally.
Question: Where is the roadmap?
Answer: Use the latest roadmap document as the source of truth.

best_practices: Provide source notes, dates, owners, and links before asking for a draft.
Review sensitive drafts with the accountable leader before sending.
Ask for concise formats when the audience needs fast status scanning.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent company facts or metrics.
Do not share confidential content without confirming audience and approval.
Do not use newsletter format for detailed team-only operational updates.

faq.question: What types of messages can this skill help draft?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ answers, status updates, leadership updates, and general internal communications.

faq.question: Does it connect to company systems automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can use context from connected tools only when those tools are separately available and authorized.

faq.question: Can it write executive-ready updates?
faq.answer: Yes. It can turn concise notes into leadership updates with clear progress, plans, problems, links, and open questions.

faq.question: How should users provide input?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, time period, source notes, links, decisions, and any facts that must be included.

faq.question: Can it handle sensitive announcements?
faq.answer: It can draft sensitive messages, but the final text should be reviewed by legal, HR, or executive owners.

faq.question: What makes the output consistent?
faq.answer: The skill uses dedicated guideline files for 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, and general communication requests.
